# Independent native terrain fixture

`terrain-rojo.rbxmx` is retained unchanged from Rojo's terrain test project at
revision `a30a8ecd0f757a23c7d5be5f91e8a4d55d87b8fc`:

https://github.com/rojo-rbx/rojo/blob/a30a8ecd0f757a23c7d5be5f91e8a4d55d87b8fc/test-projects/terrain/Terrain.rbxmx

The upstream repository license is Mozilla Public License 2.0. The full license
is included in `terrain-rojo.MPL-2.0.txt`. This fixture is not relicensed under
this repository's MIT source license. Its original source form remains alongside
the binary derivative, with upstream provenance preserved.

`terrain-rojo.rbxm` is a one-time binary normalization using Rojo 7.7.0 and a
project whose tree points directly to the XML source. No Roblox engine or cloud
service was used. Tests read the checked-in binary; Rojo is not required for
the terrain test. This normalization is not evidence of current engine acceptance.

SHA-256:

- XML: `34e83d85df1abd3e4d70d29d8ac4c13edf7fe67553e532cf6699a63a2346b6a1`.
- Binary: `ec727e2c497e32c61b57ab26db1573abbddf2573c93eb47cf7172e1eb4ef6fe2`.
